scope: Existing physical_direct_centered outer cover of the fixed 36-state scalar-TM model; each bound applies to the entire material cell.
method: Interval LDL* proves A_c* A_c − center_floor² I positive definite. Write A=(I−U D_delta K) A_c with K=U^T G A_c^{-1}. Interval solve encloses K and the cell halfwidths h give ||U D_delta K||_2 ≤ ||D_h K||_F uniformly. The whole-cell lower bound is center_floor * (1 − ||D_h K||_F).
